content.text:
Finding submitted: **deviation** on Section 14.1 (¶p0121), with a validated preferred-level redline.

- **Good news:** Section 11 has no change-of-control termination or re-pricing trigger, and the document contains no "change of control" or "deemed an assignment" language, so Commerce One cannot exit on our corporate transaction.
- **Gaps:** no affiliate carve-out for Corio, no reasonableness standard on consent, and a mutual competitor carve-back that would let Commerce One block our merger/asset sale to any of its competitors.
- **Redline:** adds an affiliate assignment right for Corio, adds "not unreasonably withheld or delayed," and confines the competitor consent requirement to Commerce One's assignments; comment offers the mutual notice-based fallback.
